EventService/HandleEvent.refund_succeeded: CONNECTOR_API_LACKS: spec ### IncomingWebhook payload table — Authipay sends exactly one OMS transaction-notification shape whose txntype field (ORIGINAL/RETURN) distinguishes payment from refund; there is no refund-specific webhook event definition separate from txntype=RETURN.
